name: 27544 · Kittrell, NC
findings: ZIP 27544 (Kittrell) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27544 (Kittrell) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 27544 (Kittrell) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
